marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Leading US chipmakers reported Q2 server AI processor shipments up 35% YoY, with major tech giants increasing 2026 capex guidance by an average of 12%.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained hardware demand will continue to support valuations across the broader AI supply chain, benefiting both upstream foundry services and enterprise software integrators.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential export restriction updates and power grid capacity constraints delaying data center deployment timelines.

marketLayer.title: HK Big Tech & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index gained 1.8% today led by major platform giants, with net Southbound inflows via Stock Connect exceeding HKD 4.5 billion for the third consecutive session.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional capital is actively re-weighting into HK tech equities, driven by attractive dividend yields, aggressive share buyback programs, and valuation bottoming signals.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Underlying domestic macroeconomic consumption momentum and geopolitical policy shifts targeting Chinese tech firms.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Strategy & Federal Reserve Rate Outlook
marketLayer.fact: US core PCE inflation print aligned with market expectations at 2.6% YoY, while weekly initial jobless claims rose slightly to 235k.
marketLayer.inference: Reinforces market pricing for a potential 25 bps rate cut in the upcoming FOMC meeting, dampening 10-year Treasury yields and providing liquidity relief to growth equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky service-sector inflation trends and potential volatility in global commodity prices affecting near-term inflation trajectories.

marketLayer.title: China/HK New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) & Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV manufacturers announced record overseas shipment figures for Q2, accompanied by new localized battery assembly partnerships in Europe and Southeast Asia.
marketLayer.inference: Global market expansion strategies are mitigating domestic price war pressures, driving margin stabilization for top-tier EV brands and component suppliers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Escalating international trade tariff disputes and regulatory compliance hurdles in primary export markets.
